title: Jury Duty
one_paragraph_synopsis: Jim returns from jury duty and shares his experience, leading to suspicions and conflicts with Dwight, who questions Jim's story and suspects he lied to avoid work. Meanwhile, Angela confesses her pregnancy was out of wedlock before her wedding, and Dwight insists the baby is his, raising questions about paternity. The office reacts with humor and concern, and Jim attempts to smooth over tensions by buying all the red licorice to replace the black licorice, but faces resistance and feelings of isolation. The episode explores themes of honesty, suspicion, and office dynamics.

main_threads.thread: Jim's jury duty experience and the office's reaction to his story.
